condition: Modify the use of the building basement parking lots approved in accordance with the license issued to it by the Municipality/ SubMunicipality
procedure: Reuse the basement parking lots in case it is closed by the landlord
Remove any building components and any storage materials in the basement that are in violation, and adhere to the maintenance of the basement parking lots and the plan of such maintenance.

condition: Non-implementation of a ramp for people with disabilities in accordance with “The Simplified Guide for Universal Accessibility Standards to Facilities
procedure: Implement a special ramp for people with disabilities in the building and ensure that it complies with the Simplified Guide for Universal Accessibility Standards to Facilities.
Maintain the building’s ramp if existed and ensure that people with disabilities can use it.

condition: Non-provision of a side access corridor in front of the special ramp for people with disabilities in accordance with (The Simplified Guide for Universal Accessibility Standards to Facilities) for commercial buildings.”
procedure: Commitment to implementing a side access corridor in front of the special ramp for people with disabilities

condition: Non-coverage of septic tanks with protective and proper covers in accordance with municipal requirements
procedure: Commitment to covering septic tanks with protective covers in accordance with municipal requirements
Replace the dilapidated covers with proper covers

condition: The existence of dilapidated or incomplete sidewalks constructed by the owner of the building or the owner of the usufruct right, - in the area towards the commercial street -”
procedure: Complete the building sidewalks, which are towards main street side
Maintain the sidewalk and ensure that it is safe and with a proper appearance.

condition: The existence of dilapidated or incomplete fences
procedure: Commitment to maintaining and repairing dilapidated and incomplete fences

condition: The existence of distorted barriers (with iron foils/ corrugated galvanized iron) on the setback fence or roof
procedure: Commitment to removing distorted barriers (with iron foils/ corrugated galvanized iron) on the setback fence or roof located towards the commercial streets

condition: There are separate air conditioning units throughout the entire facade of the building overlooking the commercial street.
procedure: Move the air conditioning units to the roof, taking into consideration non-placing their extensions on the façades of the building
Move the air conditioning units to the roof, taking care not to place their extensions on the facades of the building

condition: The existence of (electrical, plumbing, and mechanical) extensions visible on the building's whole façade that overlooks the commercial street
procedure: Commitment to remove all extensions visible on the façade overlooking the commercial streets
Cover the extensions by placing ducts covered with cladding or materials proper to the building color and shape

condition: The existence of cracks, damage (paints, cladding) or rust on the metal materials on the entire façade of the building, with a total area more than one square meter (1 m2).
procedure: Commitment to remedying cracks, damages or rust visible on the buildings’ façades

condition: The existence of satellite dishes on the balconies or the entire façade of the building that overlooks the commercial street
procedure: Commitment to removing satellite dishes visible on balconies or building façades that overlook the commercial streets
Move satellite dishes to the roof, taking into account to place their extensions on the building façades

condition: The existence of canopies or hangars outside the property boundaries
procedure: Commitment to removing canopies or hangars installed outside the building boundaries
Move canopies to be within the property boundaries.

condition: Cover balconies without obtaining the proper licenses from the Municipality/ SubMunicipality
procedure: Remove the hangars used to cover the balconies and restore the balcony state to be in according to the issued building permit

If the landlord desires to close the balcony and cover it, a (renovation) license shall be issued first to begin the work of closing the balcony, provided that such coverage shall not affect the aesthetic appearance of the building

condition: There are illegal phrases on the entire frontal façades of the building overlooking the commercial street.
procedure: Commitment to removing distorted phrases through paint or cladding works on the fence or building.

condition: Install the chimneys on the façade of the building not on the side of the building, or their height on the side of the building exceeding the building height by more than (2) meters
procedure: Move the entrances to the side of the building while ensuring that extensions are not made on the façade of the building.
Coordinate with a qualified engineering office to develop the solutions in the event that the owner wishes to hide the chimneys inside the building (for construction work)

condition: Shops boards do not comply with municipal requirements
procedure: Compliance with the requirements for shops boards

condition: The existence of boards for closed shops with invalid or expired licenses, or the presence of iron structures to install the removed boards
procedure: Commitment to removing old billboards for closed shops and removing the existing iron structures to install the removed billboards

condition: The existence of old or dilapidated advertising posters on the façade of the building
procedure: Commitment to removing old and dilapidated advertising posters on the façades of buildings and shops

condition: The existence of waste and building materials that impede movement on the building’s sidewalk.
procedure: Remove all construction waste on the sidewalk and ensure that it is free of all violating elements that impede pedestrian movement
